about: The format registry of plan 24a UC02: every definition and file format with a version the code declares. scripts/check_formats.py fails when the code declares another version than 'current' (a bump without an entry) and when a file of a frozen format changed (sha256). An open format records no hashes. 'Published definition' (definition_version.format, per kind) and the management API / compatibility generation of the 24a table are not file formats with a schema and are not listed.
